title: AI Inference Receipt
description: Frozen v1.0 schema for a deterministic AI inference audit receipt. Every field has a single unambiguous type. No additional properties are permitted.

entry_id.description: Monotonically increasing ledger entry identifier within a stream. Opaque string; ordering is caller-defined.

event_id.description: Identifier of the upstream source event that produced the input. Must be stable and non-reused within a stream.

prev_receipt_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the immediately preceding receipt in the ledger chain, or null for the first entry.

input_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical input event bytes, binding this receipt to the exact input.

input_schema_version.description: Schema version string identifying the input event envelope format (e.g. 'event-envelope/v1').

model_id.description: Human-readable model identifier. Stable within a deployment series.

model_version.description: Semantic version or tag of the model artifact.

model_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the model artifact, binding the receipt to the exact executable.

preprocess_version.description: Version of the preprocessing pipeline applied before inference.

policy_version.description: Version of the decision policy applied after inference.

framework_version.description: Exact version of the inference framework.

output.description: Raw model output values. Schema is model-specific. Must not be empty.

decision.description: Policy decision derived from model output.

classification.description: Decision label produced by the policy (e.g. 'ALERT', 'PASS', 'BLOCK').

threshold.description: Numeric threshold value used in the policy evaluation.

reason.description: Human-readable description of why the classification was reached.

observed_at.description: Wall-clock timestamp at which the receipt was recorded (ISO 8601). Excluded from receipt_hash projection; observational only.

receipt_hash.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical hash projection of this receipt. Computed from a defined subset of fields; see docs/HASH_PROJECTION.md.

signature.description: Optional cryptographic signature over receipt_hash. Validation is out of scope for v1.0 verifier.
